avis.titre: Helps Improve the Look of Dark Spots
avis.texte: I really like the Peach Slices dark spot patches and use them in cases where a blemish has left a dark spot after being resolved which sometimes happens when I get unusually large or deep blemishes. They seem to help the healing process.
have mid to darker skin and get the WORST dark spots. after using two patches i can def tell the difference. i always use these when i need a spot lightened within a few days

I bought this product because i was curious to try it on my dark spots. I LOVE the pimple patches from this brand so I had high hopes for this. Unfortunately this did nothing but made my dark spots worse.
My only issue is they don't stick to the skin well. They've fallen off in the middle of the night.
These patches did not lighten my dark spots. They irritated my skin. They do stay on though.

avis.titre: The Single Best Dark Spot Treatment I've Tried
avis.texte: I have one stubborn age spot on my left cheek that I've tried for years to address. I have used most of the major brands out there, including a well-known prescription brand. None of them have made any difference. For the past 3 nights, I have used a Dark Spot Microdart on the age spot, and I can actually see it starting to diminish in size and intensity. I apply it to clean skin before going to bed and leave it on until I wash my face in the morning. I plan to keep using them until the spot is as lightened as I can get it. I'm so happy I finally found something that works!

avis.titre: Doesn't work, hero dark spot micropoint better
avis.texte: As the title of this says. This didnt work for my dark spot, but the HERO dark spot micropoint patches did. Theyre $13 (expensive) and you have to use a lot. But they severely reduced the size and darkness of my dark spot. They didnt completley disappear since i ran out of patches but its so much lighter and amaller its fine. Normally my dark spot takes months to disappear.
These haven't worked for my acne situation, I'm sure they work for others. It certainly feels good though!

avis.titre: Works really well.Also leaves your face feeling refreshed
avis.texte: This product works really well. I feel it is good for your face. It has vitamin C in it and my face felt refreshed after using this product. For a younger smoother looking skin. This is the product you need. I would highly recommend it, and I will be buying it again.
Used all patches on the same dark spot, did not lighten even the tiniest bit. Spot actually looks darker now. Very disappointing product.
I have only used these a couple of times, but they seem to be making a good first impression! I'll try and update in a few weeks, but I think they will be helpful!
You need to apply them for a week or more, but I do see noticeable improvements in the dark spots I get from acne.
Did not improve discoloration on body acne, not sure how it works on face acne scars

I haven't had much luck with several dark spot treatments for post-acne marks. These patches work, but they take a bit of time. If you have stubborn hyperpigmentation, though, I wouldn't expect a drastic change in a few days (YMMV, though).

avis.titre: Great product, wish there were more patches per pack in smal
avis.texte: Easy to use, effective. Just wish it came with more patches per pack for this price. I also wish the packaging could be a little more sustainable. The outer packet could be half the size and use much less plastic. (This brand isn't the only one, though. They all seem to package acne patches like this, probably to communicate luxury by making the ratio of size to cost look more reasonable. But really, it's just so much unnecessary plastic. )

avis.titre: Currently, there is no response until the mail is sent twice
avis.texte: Currently, there is no response until the mail is sent twice. You can forward the invoice of the product by mail.
I've used many different pimple patches but these are holy grains! Literally follow the instructions and you'll be fine. Use as intended for the correct pimple as well.
I used every patch on one single spot, morning and night, over 8 hours each, not even a slight difference. These suck.

I never write reviews but I don't want anyone to waste their money on these like I did! I used them 3 nights in a row for 8hrs and they didn't improve my dark spots. Instead, they left a red ring and dryness around the dark spots where the adhesive sticks. Even with make up on the rings are noticable. It's been 2 days since I've used them and I still have red rings on my face. No irritation though. I've used other zit and acne patches in the past and they don't leave red rings. Don't buy!

avis.titre: Lovely and a little too light
avis.texte: Decided to use the peach slices patches on my stubborn dark marks and saw results after the first night or wearing them. Only flaw is not only is my dark spot lighter but so is the skin around it (slightly). If you are darker skinned beware of that, but it's definitely effective.
I have one age spot on my cheek. Used all the spot things and noticed no difference. Will be easier to laser off.
I have dark spots under my eyes but I notice the differences which using this product.

Unfortunately these have not worked for me. I was very hopeful because I love the other P&L products and happened to have an annoyingly prominent pimple two weeks before I ordered these. I thought that because the resultant dark acne scar was "fresh" these would help fade it. I used the entire pack (which is ONLY NINE patches to begin with) and wore them each overnight. They have had no effect whatever even though the packaging touts the effects at three days. It's possible my 45yo skin is too old for it to help but I was disappointed that there wasn't any change. They *might* help boost the already fast healing of younger skin but I didn't see it. I'll stick to the P&L serums and moisturizers.
It's a process and you have to stay on it but it does work and I would recommend these products.
I like this dark spot solution as it is both effective and travel friendly!

avis.titre: Not sure if they work yet.
avis.texte: Using for hyper pigmentation. Haven't noticed a difference yet. Will update at a later date.

avis.titre: Bit overpriced with minimal results for acne and dark spots.
avis.texte: I had high expectations for this product to treat both acne and dark spots, but I haven't noticed much improvement. Given the limited number of pads in the package, it feels quite pricey for the results.
They actually work and help get rid of dark spots. It gets rid of specific spots from zits and breakouts
I used these on some red non healing old zits that will not disappear! I think they did a pretty good job even overnight. They are worth a try!
Ive been constantly buying these because i have hormonal acne and get left with scars. After two or three repeats uses on a spot, i see drastic results!
Even with repeated application in the same spot, I did not notice an effect on my dark spots.

I was very skeptical using these but I've tried everything to lighten my dark acne spots/scars, and these actually work! Any other products end up causing more breakouts, but where these are a sticker, I didn't have any issues. I thought for sure I'd have a line of zits around the sticker, but that never happened. You definitely have to use them 3 days back to back, but I definitely saw a major difference at day 3! I went back to purchase more because some spots I've had longer and they needed more time/stickers. But they eventually went away too. I have combination skin, very pale, and sensitive. Hope my review encourages other people to try them. They're expensive but actually worth it in my opinion!
The girl who recommended this to me at the nogales, AZ store, thannnnnk you!

Used once in hopes of reducing hyperpigmentation on my face. Followed directions exactly. Instantly felt the microdarts pricking my skin. After a few minutes the spot felt like it was burning but thought maybe it was my skin getting used to the microdarts. Continued to burn. Removed after 15 minutes and now have large red spot on my face. Washed my face hoping it'd remove the microdarts ingredients. Still VERY red. I don't normally have reactions. I use various Cetaphil face products and Hero Mighty Patches regularly without issue.

I've already tried the regular spot dots, so I as excited to try this for healing my acne scars. So far they stick to the skin nicely and seem to have made a difference already. The microdarts dont hurt or anything.
Sadly this product doesn't seem to work. I didn't notice any difference in the pigmentation of my post pimple scar.
These little patches are amazing! Works in a few days at really lightening up dark spots from pimples. No irritation for my sensitive skin. I highly recommend!

avis.titre: I would not buy this product again
avis.texte: I enjoy the peach slices skin care brand. This product did not work for me. I will try the other patches to find the right fit.
These patches are amazing!! They work so well!! I have an old scar ony cheek and using these patches has really helped lighten that area. I'll definitely continue purchasing these!!
I have used several times and have noticed a lightening. I do recommend.

I experimented with two pimples that recently healed (one I applied the patch and the other I didn't). The effect is not immediate, but over time I noticed that the one I applied patches on (3-4 probably?) faded significantly quicker. It is now hardly noticeably while the other one (no patch) is still there.

I bought these to try on a sun spot. I used all nine on a single spot. Each time I removed the patch, the spot appeared lighter for about an hour, much like skin under a damp bandage appears lighter, but then it returned to its original appearance as it dried. Won't purchase again.
Helped minimize scarring from pimples. It's expensive for the amount you get but worth it.
I use all the patches in this line because they work! They do not fall off during the night as I've read in some of the reviews.

Seconds after applying these patches I felt a burning sensation that did not let up. I waited for it to go away but after 15 minutes you could see how red the area was turning through the patch. I decided to take them off and they burned my skin. Huge bright red spots right where the patch was. Ive used many pimple patches including salicylic acid with tea tree and have never felt this before.
I saw noticable improvement in my dark spot within 1 day not only that but it stayed on during a 2 mile run and all throughout my sleep
Noticeably lighter in discoloration from scarring within only a few uses

You have to be patient with vitamin C, it's takes longer to work. So I have been using these at night and P&L vitamin C spot treatment in the morning. I struggle with dark spots constantly, but this has been speeding up the process!
Seems to have slightly lightened a few spots, tho I know I should probably try more treatments to test. They are very easy to use and stick well, and I had no issues wearing them to sleep.
Definitely BEGAN to reduce the appearance of scars. I do agree with other reviewers that they should be sold in larger quantities. : )
These are easy to use. The microdots really get up in there. I have had some fading of dark spots but have used numerous dots. Getting kinda expensive but it helps.
I am really amazed by the results. I have tried so many products and never got such results.

I used these for two small areas on my face. I used them twice and now the entire area where the patch was is red. I have had two red circles on my face and its been 3 days since i used them. Do not recommend.
Good for dark spots you have to use them multiple days in a row to see changes which is normal. Good deal.

avis.titre: This didn't do much. If i
avis.texte: This didn't do much. If it is going to work, then you need to keep using a patch on the area, which means you go through them very quickly.

avis.titre: I do think this reduced t
avis.texte: I do think this reduced the darkness of some of my spots. Not a lot but definitely a bit!
Best patch ever!! Helps with pimple scar! Love it so much. Will be buying more
I tried these for some dark marks from old pimples for three days and didn't really notice much difference. I'll use up the pack but I don't think they did enough for me to re-buy.

Used all 9 patches and they don't do anything to lighten my one dark spot. Additionally, the adhesive is so strong that when i pulled the last one off it irritaed my skin so now i have irritation bumps right around my dark spot.

I have several areas of dark pigmentation from years of sun exposure. I decided to try the microdots just to see if they made a difference. I have been pleasantly surprised with the results after 2 applications. They are still present but a good 50-60 percent lighter. I plan to continue to use them on occasion to see if they will continue to improve these area. I'm very happy to see these results!
Mirodarts have proven results, though I have some deeper darker spots, they have lightened up. Thank you PL.

I have what my mom always referred to as 'strawberries' they are little red spots that appear to be broken blood vessels. I used these patches on them, and to my surprise, they helped clear them! I do have to apply every night for like a week, but the most faded one I experimented with to see if it would come back, but it is still faded! I would love for a larger pack to come out, since there are only 9 patches, I go through them super quick.
Love it easy to apply see results gradually with more application
These are great for hyperpigmentation after acne. I used them once and it fixed my color by lightening the scar. It looks great.

avis.titre: These work but take multiple applications
avis.texte: I love these patches and they do work to help fade dark spots, but you only get 9 patches, so they are kinda pricey. I get the best results when I use them 2-3 days in a row on my acne scars.

I am attempting to get rid of dark spots. It's more of a challenge than I realized. I have tried several different brands of patches and creams. Peach & Lilly is working best. I just started using Glass Skin Refining Lotion. Need to do more with dark spots before getting best results, but I love the feel and look of the product.
Really like the convenience of these patches. The concentrated serum works well during my down time from treatments with the esthetician .
I have not noticed a significant difference in my acne scars. I guess it's early days, but I do appreciate the concept of this product.
Thankfully I need these less and less, but they work wonders every time.
Pay attention to the directions, and do hold it onto skin for the 15 seconds, it makes a difference. Use consistently for best results.
I can definitely see a difference. Sun damage is lighter and less noticeable. I plan to use more and expect to continue to see positive results.
Used this a few times for some of my post-acne spots. The effect is fairly subtle. I think I would still prefer using some vitamin C or a gentle AHA for spot treatment.
Easy to use overnight or during the day under makeup. Lightens up the dark spots!

They work well but when i use them around my mouth area my skin gets very VERY red and it burns. I am assuming they arent for use on sensitive skin so be careful about where you place them, I have what looks like two round burns on my face now.
This is a convenient travel friendly product that does lighten up dark spots from, in my case, inflammatory hyperpigmentation and sunspots. Granted, they weren't "huge", but it helped.

avis.titre: Hoping this would remove a dark spot on my cheek… nope!
avis.texte: This product looked promising, I used it for 9 nights in a row- the number of tabs in the box- but it didn't work! Too bad.

Product is actually doing what it claims to do...slowly fade my brown spots (sun damage). Easy to apply, must use consistently for a number of days to see hyperpigmentation completely disappear...but it works!
I'm a fan bc I can see marginal differences after each use. I have some moles that are developing under the surface of my forehead, so I used the microdarts as a way to mitigate them.

These little dots work wonders on my hyperpigmentation and scars. The little spikes feel a tad scratchy at first but by no means hurt, I was just surprised when I put them on for the first time. If you're dealing with uneven skin tone these are definitely worth a shot.
Was something to try. Have only used it once but would try it again to see! Seemed to work better on recent dark marks versus older ones.

These are great for using right after the pimple has been popped or fresh acne scarring. I used this and my scarring peeled right off, revealing brighter skin. this pairs well with serum, so I used the discoloration serum by good molecules underneath.

I'm new to the patch world and I thought this was worth a shot considering the price point and its claims. I have a dark sun spot and my boyfriend has an even darker one. We've been using it every night before bed and we've noticed a significant difference after day 3! It's incredible! I thought we were going to have to get it professionally treated with a laser, but this are crushing it! I'm excited to order more.
It doesnt work as fast as I would like but i do see a small difference every day that I use them.

avis.titre: I have a perfectly round scar from the product on my face!
avis.texte: I need to be contacted by upper management in regards to the scar on my face caused by the micro dart.

I think these worked a bit to reduce my post acne hyperpigmentation, but not entirely sure, as I use a lot of products to help with this. I so wish they provided more in one pack, as I used these up really fast, and I feel like you need to use a couple consistently on one spot to really see a noticeable difference. Really love the idea of this product though, and am looking forward to testing it out further.

Context: Caucasian with dry skin. Using on half dime-sized dark red spot that was the aftermath of a zit a week prior, now completely healed. I used several days in a row on the same red dark spot. Application is easy and completely painless. I don't think the "darts" go deep enough in the skin to accomplish anything, but I'm no dermatologist. The only changes I saw in this dark spot reflected normal healing changes over the span of a week. In other words, it usually takes a week to lighten WITHOUT these patches. So it lightening slightly with the patches wasn't impressive to me. Either they need to define what type of dark spot this is ment to deal with or it just doesn't work, in my opinion.
I've bought these micro darts about 3 times in the past month…can't completely tell if they are working just yet…easy to apply and stays on throughout the night

avis.titre: It's ok…but I wouldn't purchase again
avis.texte: The patches are easy to use and did not irritate my skin. However after using the entire package, i didnt notice any difference.
You can really see the difference! Lightens up dark spots after a couple uses
Used 5 microdarts on the same spot for 5 days. The dark spot only got darker with each patch. Sucks it did work for me.
I used these each day until they ran out and saw NO improvements at all. I feel like I wasted my money. Do not purchase these find another alternative.
i've been using this product continuously every night since i got it & when i look at the before pictures, my blemish was way lighter than what it is now after i used them.
